args: import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const runner = await import("@alunza/runner"); const image = await import("./infra/runner/docker-image.mjs"); if (process.getuid() !== 1000 || typeof image.readImageIdentity !== "function") throw new Error("PACKAGING_ASSERTION_FAILED"); const child = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["scripts/runner-probe.mjs", "--adapter", "vercel"], { encoding: "utf8", timeout: 10000 }); const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(".local/reports/imp-00-06-08/runner-vercel.json", "utf8")); if (child.status !== 2 || report.reason !== "APPROVED_MANIFEST_REQUIRED" || report.remoteCalls !== 0 || report.status !== "PENDING") throw new Error("PROBE_GUARD_ASSERTION_FAILED"); console.log(JSON.stringify({runnerVersion: runner.RUNNER_VERSION, imageHelper: "loaded", uid: process.getuid(), probeExitCode: child.status, reason: report.reason, remoteCalls: report.remoteCalls, status: report.status}));
